statements.impact_statement: Reviewed by Codex on 2026-10-02: node-forge 1.4.0 occurs only under development-only web-ext 10.6.0 / @devicefarmer/adbkit 3.3.9 in the tab-import companion lockfile. adbkit contains affected RSA verification in its TCP/USB authentication server, but Blanc's lint, build, and sign commands never load the Android runner or start that server. These dependencies are absent from the desktop dependency graph and companion archive. Evidence and re-review conditions: docs/security-reviews/2026-10-02-node-forge.md. This does not cover direct adbkit use or web-ext's Android run target.

The affected image-size parser is reachable only through web-ext while maintainers lint or package committed companion-extension files. Blanc does not pass network, user, or release-time input to this parser.

The affected image-size parser is reachable only through web-ext while maintainers lint or package committed companion-extension files. Blanc does not pass network, user, or release-time input to this parser.

The affected adm-zip extraction is a development-only web-ext path operating on committed companion-extension sources and a maintainer-selected local output directory. It is absent from Blanc release payloads and receives no untrusted archive or destination path.

Reviewed by Claude on 2026-10-06 and approved by the owner: sprintf-js 1.1.3 occurs only under development-only electron-builder (via @electron/get 3.1.0, its optional global-agent 3.0.0, and roarr 2.15.4). @electron/get loads global-agent only when ELECTRON_GET_USE_PROXY is set, which no Blanc script, workflow, or configuration does, and every global-agent log call passes a constant format string, so no adversary controls the precision specifier the advisory requires. Absent from the desktop runtime graph, release payloads, the website, and the tab-import Worker and companions. Evidence and re-review conditions: docs/security-reviews/2026-10-06-sprintf-js.md.
